title: Secret-valued non-bearer header channel: auth {"type":"header","name":"<header>","secret":"<alias>"} (after 0.1.0)
description: Filed, not built, and targeted AFTER the 0.1.0 cut: it is not part of DEC-246 and stays out of the release PR (ward-cli#180). Source: DEC-233 (a43), recorded in opum-ai/opum-doc#1408, relayed by the opum-agent leader, token lead329-ward-header-task. WHAT: a secret-valued header channel that is not a bearer token, shaped as {"type":"header","name":"x-vercel-protection-bypass","secret":"<alias>"}. TODAY: a profile auth block carries only type and secret, and the type must be bearer (src/domain/profile.ts, the auth normalizer refuses any other type or extra key as unsupported), so a credential that must travel in a named header cannot be expressed. FIRST CONSUMER: opum-app alias OPUM_APP_VERCEL_CHECK_TOKEN, a Vercel Deployment Protection bypass that is already minted. Its profile will pin the stable git-branch preview alias of opum-app dev branch. DESIGN NOTES, not decisions: adding a type changes what normalizeProfile accepts, so profileSnapshotVersion bumps in the same change (ADR 0018, the rule in src/domain/profile.ts), and the exact key-set comparison stays (ADR 0023). Header-name rules (case, reserved names such as Authorization, duplicates against the profile headers map) and how the value is kept out of output and audit are design questions for opum-doc, not settled here. Use synthetic credentials only in tests.

acceptanceCriteria.text: opum-doc records the design for the header type: allowed and refused header names, interaction with the profile headers map, and redaction
A profile with auth type header and a secret alias normalizes, is approved, and the value reaches the request only in the named header, with the value never in output, audit or the snapshot
profileSnapshotVersion is bumped in the same change and a version-2 snapshot is refused, tested
The opum-app profile pinning the dev branch preview alias is approvable by the developer, shown on synthetic data in this repository and with the real alias by the operator
